messages:
Jen R.: kicking off quiet bake for release `v2.14.0-rc3` -> canary 10% in eu-west. DeployBot should start the rollout now, i'll watch the heatcheck at +7m. react :white_check_mark: to go or :no_entry: to pause
DeployBot: [automated] started canary rollout v2.14.0-rc3 -> eu-west -> 10%. track: https://internal.metrics/release/v2.14.0-rc3 · eta heatcheck +7m
Marco: p50 and p95 for generation latency jumped ~70ms in the last 2 minutes on the canary fleet, not the whole region but the subset. seeing KV cache evictions in the nodes serving rc3
Sasha: can you paste the eviction logs?
Marco: sure — snippet:
```
[2026-03-21T12:17:02Z] kv-cache: miss_ratio=0.42 evictions=1023 backlog=5
[2026-03-21T12:17:08Z] inference: req_lat_p95=483ms req_lat_p50=210ms
```
Marco: also a few 502s at the edge, small sample (0.03%)
Matt (oncall): thanks, i'm looking at infra — autoscaler triggered an extra node but they all show degraded cache warmup. not seeing memory OOMs though
Priya: QA is watching relevance evals — no quality regression flagged yet but latency could affect UX on chat flows
Jen R.: ok quick decision time. options: 1) pause and revert traffic to stable in eu-west, 2) hold canary and let cache warm (10m), 3) continue and monitor. please vote with emoji — we need at least 2 :white_check_mark: to continue or 1 :no_entry: to pause (ops decision)
Sasha: :no_entry: — prefer pause and pin until we figure cache warming pattern
Marco: :no_entry: — leaning pause, mitigations (force warm, kv cache tuning) need infra action
Matt (oncall): :white_check_mark: if we can force-warm quickly, otherwise pause. I can run a targeted warm script in the next 2 min
Lina (QA): :no_entry: — 10% users already seeing slow responses, would rather rollback for now
Jen R.: tally: 2 no_entry, 1 check, 1 check from deploybot not counting. I'm pausing rollout. DeployBot, pause and pin canary for eu-west and set routing back to stable-2026-03-18. also open a rollback-runbook ticket
DeployBot: [automated] pausing rollout: v2.14.0-rc3 -> eu-west. Reverting traffic to stable-2026-03-18. Pin applied. Ticket created: RB-4521.
Matt (oncall): running warm script now on the canary subset (one-off) — will re-run heatcheck after 6 minutes and report
Marco: creating a short infra PR to reduce eviction pressure (kv cache tuning) — will link here when up
Jen R.: thanks everyone. post-mortem notes: do not resume before warmup verification + 15m bake and a green heatcheck. if infra change is deployed, we'll coordinate a new quiet bake window.
Lina (QA): copying steps to repro into RB-4521 — include sample prompts and logs
Priya: noting release notes update to mention temporary pause and that we rolled back eu-west users
Jen R.: closing this thread — followups in RB-4521 and the deploy release board. :thumbsup:
